title: Кібератака на державні організації України з використанням шкідливих програми Cobalt Strike Beacon, GrimPlant та GraphSteel (CERT-UA#4145)

entities.name: UAC-0056
entities.gloss: A cyberespionage threat actor targeting Ukrainian organizations and government entities.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A sovereign country in Eastern Europe.

entities.name: державні органи України
entities.gloss: State authorities and governmental organizations of Ukraine.

entities.name: forkscenter[.]fr
entities.gloss: A malicious domain used to distribute malware payloads masquerading as software updates.

entities.name: nirsoft[.]me
entities.gloss: A malicious domain used for command-and-control communication by threat actors.
An IP address used as command-and-control infrastructure for malware.
An IP address identified as part of the malicious network infrastructure.

entities.name: Discord
entities.gloss: A digital communication platform misused by threat actors to host and distribute malicious files.

entities.name: Themida
entities.gloss: A commercial software protection and packing tool used to evade detection and reverse engineering.

entities.name: GraphSteel
entities.gloss: A Go-based backdoor malware capable of harvesting credentials, executing commands, and exfiltrating data.

entities.name: GrimPlant
entities.gloss: A Go-based backdoor malware that collects system information and executes remote commands via gRPC.

entities.name: Cobalt Strike Beacon
entities.gloss: An agent component of the Cobalt Strike commercial penetration testing tool, often used as a backdoor.

entities.name: BitdefenderWindowsUpdatePackage.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable disguised as an antivirus update package used to drop loaders.

entities.name: alt.exe
entities.gloss: A downloader executable protected by Themida that retrieves subsequent payloads from Discord.

entities.name: one.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable that deploys Cobalt Strike Beacon and executes additional downloaders.

entities.name: dropper.exe
entities.gloss: A Go-based downloader executable that drops and executes java-sdk.exe.

entities.name: wisw.exe
entities.gloss: A downloader executable designed to retrieve payloads from Discord.

entities.name: cesdf.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable payload hosted on Discord.

entities.name: java-sdk.exe
entities.gloss: A Go-based downloader establishing persistence and deploying GraphSteel and GrimPlant backdoors.

entities.name: microsoft-cortana.exe
entities.gloss: An executable file containing the GraphSteel backdoor payload.

entities.name: oracle-java.exe
entities.gloss: An executable file containing the GrimPlant backdoor payload.

entities.name: Інструкція з антивірусного захисту.doc
entities.gloss: A decoy document used in phishing lures regarding antivirus protection.

entities.name: Інструкція користувачів.doc
entities.gloss: A decoy document used in phishing lures containing fake user instructions.
